summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 3 to its Subscription Agreement with MassMutual. The amendment extends the start of the company's obligation to repurchase MassMutual's Class N shares from January 1, 2026 to April 1, 2028, and revises monthly repurchase amounts based on net proceeds from share sales and an affiliate fund. No specific price/share, premium, or deal value is disclosed. This is a contractual modification to existing repurchase terms, not a special situation. Watch for liquidity impact and future repurchase activity.
